ProgramUnit.Name: FIND_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FIND_DATA IS
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT distinct u.unit_id, u.batch_id 
 FROM units u, rgt_result_parms r, utrs ut
 WHERE --u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id --MLT# 469
 r.result_parm_id = :ctrl_blk_1.parm_id
 AND r.batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 AND r.batch_id = u.batch_id
 --AND r.chapter_id = u.chapter_id --MLT# 469
 AND u.unit_id = ut.unit_id
 AND ut.test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND ut.extract_date = r.insert_dats;
-- AND exists
-- (SELECT 'x' FROM utrs
-- WHERE unit_id = u.unit_id
-- AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
-- AND extract_date = r.insert_dats);
BEGIN
 go_block('unit_details');
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.parm_id is not null THEN
 FOR b_rec in C1
 LOOP
 :unit_details.unit_id := b_rec.unit_id;
 :unit_details.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(b_rec.unit_id,null,null);
 :unit_details.batch_id := b_rec.batch_id;
 :test_count := nvl(:test_count ,0) + 1;
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT unit_id, batch_id 
 INTO :unit_details.unit_id, :unit_details.batch_id
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND exists 
 (SELECT 'x' FROM utrs
 WHERE unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id 
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND extract_date is not null);
 :unit_details.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, null, null);
 :test_count := nvl(:test_count ,0) + 1;
 next_record;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN 
 null;
 END;
 END IF; 
 clear_message;
 IF :system.cursor_record = 1 AND
 :unit_details.unit_id is null 
 THEN
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 check_package_failure;
 show_error('2331');
 ELSE
 first_record;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_PROC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE commit_proc IS
BEGIN
 go_block('unit_details');
 first_record;
 loop
 UPDATE utrs
 SET extract_date = null
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_details.unit_id
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND extract_date is not null
 AND ((:ctrl_blk_1.parm_id is not null 
 and extract_date = 
 (SELECT insert_dats from rgt_result_parms
 WHERE result_parm_id = :ctrl_blk_1.parm_id
 AND batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id))
 or (:ctrl_blk_1.parm_id is null));
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 END loop; 
 :system.message_level := 10;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 show_error('8010');
END;
